snippet.title: The Blessing of Airon Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore the echoes of a world similar to our own, but one that suffers from the very real threat of Neural Demonic Phenomenae.

As you venture into the world of The Blessing of Airon, there are items around every corner that tell the story of this seemingly quiet community. In many ways, their world is like our own... but in many ways it is not.

Why are its people so frightened, superstitious even, about "electronics"?

Should you yourself be frightened?

Inspect a wide variety of objects, find notes for your journal, solve puzzles and explore areas filled with rich story details to unravel the mystery of this unique world. 

 Available October 2025 for PC on Steam.
